title: Three Weeks and One Short Reel
subtitle: 影视艺术 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 影视艺术（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·影视与戏剧）
meta: 主题语境：影视艺术（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·影视与戏剧）　|　核心词汇：film　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 film 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my uncle ① shot a film that no critic in the town would have reviewed, and he said the shooting was the whole of the autumn. The ② film, meaning the picture itself and not the play, ran three weeks and stayed unreviewed in the book; a film, he said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how long it is left unreviewed.

Every ③ film in that town had the same short reel beside it, and the ④ film at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A film, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to watch; my uncle said the watching is the part that fills three weeks.

My aunt meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the film was the whole of the matter, meaning the layer and not the picture. The ⑥ film, meaning the layer and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody watches; film, she said, is either something you shoot or the only word that means both a picture and a layer. She said the layer is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ film had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short reel. The ⑧ film of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in October, was one town and three weeks of watching; film, he said, is either the one at the far end or the reason you learned to watch. He said the watching was never mentioned.

The ⑨ film I remember is the one written in the plan, which closed in 1966 and is still described as the quietest in the town. A ⑩ film, my mother said in 1968, is the only one that improves by being watched; every film, she said, is a layer that has agreed to look like a picture. She said the layer was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 电影；影片（指镇上每一部旁边的那一部）
B. n. 电影（指那一部本身，与戏剧相对）
C. 固定搭配：shoot a film 拍一部电影
D. n. 电影（指留给孩子们的那一部）
E. n. 电影（抽象总称，指一个镇上的影片之事）
F. n. 电影（指计划里写到、被人看过的那一部）
G. n. 薄膜；薄层（指一件事里人人都等却无人看到的那样东西）
H. n. 薄层（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人看到的那样东西）

items.q: shot a film that no critic in the town would have reviewed
The film, meaning the picture itself and not the play
the film at the far end
the film was the whole of the matter
the film had become a line in a plan
The film of the whole thing
A film, my mother said in 1968

answers.why: shoot a film 意为“拍一部电影”，1957 年叔叔拍了一部镇上没有一位评论家肯评的电影。
film 意为“电影”，指那一部本身而不是戏剧，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被评过。
film 意为“电影”，指镇上每一部旁边的那一部，每一部旁边都有同一卷短短的胶片。
film 意为“电影”，指留给孩子们的那一部，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
film 意为“薄膜、薄层”，指一件事里人人都等却无人看到的那样东西，姑姑说这层薄膜就是那件事的全部。
film 意为“薄层”，指人人都等却无人看到的那样东西而不是那一部电影，是事情里人人都等、却无人看到的东西。
film 意为“电影”，指计划里写到、被人看过的那一部，到 1964 年这一部成了计划里的一行。
film 意为“电影”，叔叔十月写道，整件事的影片之事是一个镇子和三个星期的观看。
film 意为“电影”，我记得的是计划里写下的那一部，1966 年结束了，至今仍被说成镇上最安静的一部。
film 为抽象总称，母亲 1968 年说，一部电影是唯一会因为被好好看过而变得更好的东西。

那部电影，指的是那一部本身而不是戏剧，经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被评过。（film）

The film at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My aunt said the film was the whole of the matter, meaning the layer and not the picture.
